notes.title: Terry's Other Games v1.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Got a little update for the collection ready, and here's what's in it!



 - The collection is now Steam deck verified!

 - Added Japanese localisation.

 - Added Latin American Spanish localisation.

 - "Reduced Motion" accessibility option slows down or removes fast moving screen effects in most games.

 - Keyboard and Gamepad rebinding supported for all games.

 - Options menu is now accessible from the main game launcher.

 - Language selection screen is now shown on first startup.

 - Fixed a visual problem with some scenes in At a Distance.

 - Couple of other minor bug fixes.



Thanks for playing the collection, hope you've enjoyed it. All the best <3

Terry
